event_station_013@node_spine_2.quirk: They drink from a mug with a faded logo of a company that no longer exists.

shipLog.text: ◆ Arriving at station! CHIP's commercial partners have numerous products available here! Some of them are things you need! This is a coincidence that CHIP finds meaningful!
◆ Planting registered! Your crop's warranty begins NOW and covers nothing! Nature has never accepted liability!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 1! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Paperwork: “Sign everything without reading”! BOLD leadership!
◆ Asteroid field! Raw commodities in their natural habitat! CHIP calls this 'the produce aisle!'
NOW ARRIVING: Supply Point 7 (There Is No Supply…! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS.…
◆ The medic's notes cite a real discipline: keeping humans healthy in space is a whole field of medicine.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Something Going Around: “Run triage properly”! BOLD leadership!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Market Row: “BACK TO DOCK”! BOLD leadership!

identity.name: Wembly Voss
identity.story: They are, or were, a terraforming compliance inspector. They faked their own retirement party — cake, speeches, a commemorative plaque they show you with genuine pride — and walked onto your ship the same night. They have inspected forty-one colonies. They wanted to see one begin.
identity.line: I have thirty years of experience and a plaque. I can be useful. The plaque is also available.
identity.join_note: Knows colony regulations from the enforcement side. Insufferable and invaluable at paperwork moments.
